entries: Upstream source lineage for the creator-recommended project
Canonical multplatform project home; includes Fabric/Forge distributions
Official CurseForge distribution linked by upstream
notes: Chunk 31 canonical measurement against the sealed 987/672 baseline resolves five existing identities (Distant Horizons, Sodium, Bliss Shaders, Tectonic, Exposure) and exactly four absent canonical families (Iris, C2ME, Terra, Terralith).
Iris is pinned to IrisShaders/Iris and its official Modrinth/CurseForge/project-site lineage; unrelated forks are excluded.
C2ME is pinned to RelativityMC/C2ME-fabric / ishland's Concurrent Chunk Management Engine distribution. The unrelated mituba4154 fork and C2ME OpenCL addon are explicitly excluded.
Terra is PolyhedralDev's world-generation platform. The upstream project itself links Modrinth and CurseForge distributions; unrelated same-name terrain projects are excluded.

Terralith is Stardust Labs' worldgen project. Source semantics remain mod because that is how the creator listed it, while its canonical Modrinth home is datapack-backed and publishes Fabric/Forge/NeoForge/Quilt packages.
No substitute, reupload, fork rewrite, or unrelated same-name project is included.
